about: The official list of Tablefolk packages. Built-in entries are rebuilt by tools/registry.mjs; add yours to "community" in a pull request. Also found in the app: npm packages and GitHub repos with the keyword/topic "tablefolk".

builtin.name: Bard
builtin.description: Songs that affect everyone who hears them (an example of a skill with a code module).

builtin.name: Healing
builtin.description: Bind wounds with bandages: a slower, mana-free heal.

builtin.name: Magic
builtin.description: Cast spells from a spellbook, paid for with mana that comes back slowly.

builtin.name: Thievery
builtin.description: Pick pockets: lift an item or a few coins from someone next to you.

builtin.name: Trade
builtin.description: Buys and sells: wares and prices on the state card, offers read from the customer's words, a lowest price, sales only when the buyer agrees.

builtin.name: Companion
builtin.description: Travels with the player: keeps up (run by code), helps, talks about what it sees.

builtin.name: Guard
builtin.description: Keeps watch, questions strangers, stands up to trouble.

builtin.name: Innkeeper
builtin.description: Keeps the inn: sells food, drink and beds, and passes on gossip.

builtin.name: Quest giver
builtin.description: Needs help with something: gives a quest and a reward.

builtin.name: Shopkeeper
builtin.description: Runs a shop: sells its wares at its prices, haggles a little, never under its lowest price.

builtin.name: Villager
builtin.description: Lives here: chats and shares what it knows about the place.

builtin.name: Smithy
builtin.description: An example package with one of everything: a blacksmith role, a smithing skill, an anvil you can strike, and a little code (the smith hammers between customers; the bellows).
